requests.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: private production master for a children's coloring app. Input image 1 is the exact edit target and coordinate/layout guide. Input image 2 is a quality/style reference ONLY. Turn image 1 into a richly finished, softly rendered storybook illustration at the craft quality of image 2. Keep the same canvas aspect ratio 4:5, white margins, exact position, scale, silhouette, pose, number of objects and boundaries of every colored part. Do not recenter, crop or zoom. Replace heavy black outlines with delicate color-matched edges and natural occlusion. Model rounded forms, contact shadows, coherent soft upper-left light and restrained highlights. Keep each part's base color from image 1; no new parts, scenery, labels, decoration, drop shadow outside the subject or watermark. This master will be separated into colorless lighting and recolored at runtime, so spatial registration is critical. Render the young boy with a friendly soft child face and rosy cheeks, chestnut locks with flowing strands, rich lavender/violet cloth with coherent draped folds and gentle woven detail, gold stars and clasp, warm brown leather boots, polished brass lantern with blue glass and warm candlelight. Keep the face anatomy and exact eye positions, no eyelashes, no extra stars or decorations. Lantern glow must remain inside existing parts.
